sections.title: Warm-up
sections.prompt: Name a social issue that is debated in your country and two perspectives on it.
items: Die Debatte um soziale Gerechtigkeit ist vielschichtig.
sections.lede: Say each line aloud once. This section is not scored.

sections.title: Learning objectives
sections.lede: These are the three things you will be able to do by the end of the lesson.

sections.title: The big picture
sections.lede: Complex public debates require precise vocabulary and the ability to present more than one perspective without flattening it.

blocks.text: A social debate usually involves competing values: freedom, security, fairness, cohesion. Describe the values behind each position before you evaluate them. This makes your own position more credible and avoids the impression that you are simply repeating a slogan.

Use precise nouns and cautious verbs: “Die Debatte um soziale Gerechtigkeit ist vielschichtig”, “Die Maßnahme dürfte kurzfristig entlasten, langfristig aber Risiken bergen”. Avoid totalising claims such as “alle” or “niemand” unless the evidence supports them.

blocks.title: Complexity is not vagueness
blocks.text: You can be precise about complexity: name the two values in tension, the trade-off and the uncertainty. That is different from saying “it depends” and stopping.

sections.title: Rules & patterns
sections.lede: The patterns to keep in mind while you work through the examples.

rows: Die Maßnahme entlastet kurzfristig, birgt aber langfristige Risiken.
Aus meiner Sicht überwiegen die Vorteile, weil …

items: “Gerechtigkeit” is fairness or justice; “Gleichheit” is equality.
Use “einerseits … andererseits” for two perspectives, not for two unrelated facts.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.lede: Listen once, then read the example aloud.

items.example: Die Debatte um soziale Gerechtigkeit ist vielschichtig.
items.exampleEn: The debate about social justice is complex.
The measure is intended to relieve families.

items.example: Der soziale Zusammenhalt ist eine zentrale Frage.
items.exampleEn: Social cohesion is a central question.

sections.title: Example sentences
sections.lede: Notice how the pattern behaves in a complete sentence.

items.de: Die Debatte um soziale Gerechtigkeit ist vielschichtig.
items.en: The debate about social justice is complex.

items.de: Die einen betonen die Freiheit, die anderen die Sicherheit.
items.note: A balanced presentation of two perspectives.

items.de: Die Maßnahme entlastet kurzfristig, birgt aber langfristige Risiken.
items.en: The measure provides short-term relief but carries long-term risks.
items.note: A trade-off expressed in one sentence.

items.de: Aus meiner Sicht überwiegen die Vorteile, weil …
items.en: From my perspective the advantages outweigh, because …
items.note: A clear position with a reason.

sections.title: Pronunciation
sections.lede: Short, focused sound work. Play each item and repeat it twice.

blocks.text: German public debate often refers to the “soziale Marktwirtschaft” and the balance between market and social protection. Understanding this background helps you follow arguments about fairness and responsibility.
Political language can be technical. Terms such as “Entlastung”, “Umverteilung” and “Teilhabe” carry strong assumptions; check what the speaker means by them.

sections.title: Dialogue in context
sections.lede: Read the scene, then play it and follow the speakers.
sections.setting: A radio discussion about a new family benefit.

lines.speaker: Moderatorin
lines.en: Does the measure really relieve families?

lines.speaker: Gast A
lines.de: Kurzfristig ja. Langfristig birgt sie aber Risiken für die öffentlichen Finanzen.
lines.en: In the short term, yes. In the long term, however, it carries risks for public finances.

lines.speaker: Gast B
lines.de: Die einen betonen die Kosten, die anderen den sozialen Zusammenhalt.
lines.en: Some emphasise costs, others social cohesion.

lines.speaker: Moderatorin
lines.de: Lässt sich das überhaupt gegeneinander abwägen?
lines.en: Can these even be weighed against each other?

sections.title: Grammar spotlight
sections.heading: Framing a debate
sections.lede: Name the values, the trade-off and your own position separately.

blocks.text: “Abwägen” means to weigh up: Wir müssen die Kosten gegen den Nutzen abwägen. It is a useful verb for balanced argumentation.

sections.tip: Separate description from evaluation. First show what each side values, then say where you stand.

exercises.explanation: The fronted phrase is followed by the verb.

sections.title: Speaking
sections.lede: Record or say your answer aloud, then compare it with the model.
sections.prompt: Present a social issue, two perspectives and your own position with one reason.

model.de: Die Debatte um soziale Gerechtigkeit ist vielschichtig. Die einen betonen die Freiheit, die anderen die Sicherheit. Die Maßnahme entlastet kurzfristig, birgt aber langfristige Risiken. Aus meiner Sicht überwiegen die Vorteile, weil der soziale Zusammenhalt wichtiger ist.
model.en: The debate about social justice is complex. Some emphasise freedom, others security. The measure provides short-term relief but carries long-term risks. From my perspective the advantages outweigh because social cohesion is more important.

tips: Name the values behind each perspective.
Use one sentence for the trade-off.
State your position last, with a clear reason.

sections.title: Common mistakes
sections.lede: These are the errors learners most often make with this pattern.

items.wrong: Die Debatte über soziale Gerechtigkeit ist vielschichtig.
items.right: Die Debatte um soziale Gerechtigkeit ist vielschichtig.
items.why: The standard collocation is die Debatte um etwas.

items.wrong: Die einen betonen Freiheit, die anderen betonen Sicherheit auch.
items.right: Die einen betonen die Freiheit, die anderen die Sicherheit.
items.why: The parallel structure does not need an extra auch.

items.wrong: Aus meiner Sicht die Vorteile überwiegen.
items.right: Aus meiner Sicht überwiegen die Vorteile.
items.why: After a fronted phrase, the verb comes before the subject.
